newsitem.title: BELGIUM: G-Bank prices cap increase at 10,250 Bfr.
newsitem.headline: G-Bank prices cap increase at 10,250 Bfr.

text.p: Generale Bank NV, Belgium's biggest bank, said in a statement on Wednesday it was pricing its 1-for-10 capital increase, due to start on September 19, at 10,250 francs per new share with VVPR coupon strip attached.
The issue will run from September 19 to October 4 inclusive.

Generale Bank chief executive Ferdinand Chaffart said on September 10 that the issue price would be based on the bank's share price between September 10 and 18, minus a discount of seven to 12 percent.
The new shares will have the right to dividend as from January 1, 1996.
On the basis of the share price on September 9, the capital increase in the proportion of one new share for 10 existing meant an increase of approximately 15 billion francs.
